text:
lyla park: FYI we started a scim bulk-replace after the key rotation and are now seeing a flurry of deprovisions + missing audit entries. anyone from infra awake? :alarm_clock:
dmitri kozlov: oncall here. quick details?
lyla park: ~1.8k deprovisions in 6m, a subset re-created by retry workers. audit stream shows a ~75s gap. some service tokens failed auth.
kevin b.: can you paste the worker/KMS error?
lyla park: snippet:
```
scim-svc[runner] ERROR decrypt: KMS.InvalidCiphertext for external_id=ext-922 code=InvalidCiphertextException key=alias/redwood-2026-rot
scim-svc WARNING retrying user=ext-922 job=bulk-replace
```
audit-bot: audit-ingestor alert: downstream batch lost at 6532110002 (GC pause suspected). trace=trc-f3c2
dmitri kozlov: timeline guess: 6532109978 rotate alias -> new key material, 6532109986 RBAC patch applied removing decrypt on old alias for scim principal, 6532109988 bulk job started.
lyla park: yep, RBAC removal was part of PR #5112. looks like some records still encrypted under old key. scim lost ability to decrypt and enqueued retries which caused duplicate lifecycle churn.
kevin b.: immediate actions: 1) pause bulk-replace 2) restore decrypt permission for scim principal against old alias(s) 3) prevent retry worker from auto-reprovisioning until deduped 4) replay missing audit batch marked as backfill.
lyla park: paused the job at 6532109996. deprov rate dropping.
dmitri kozlov: rolling RBAC revert now (allow kms:Decrypt for principal scim-service on alias/*) — applying in canary then prod.
audit-bot: job queued: AUDIT-REPLAY-77 for window 6532109988-6532110010
kevin b.: once RBAC is reverted, run a dry decrypt test from a scim pod against both aliases. simple one-liner: ```kubectl exec scim-0 -- aws kms decrypt --ciphertext-blob fileb://ciph --key-id alias/redwood-2026-rot```
dmitri kozlov: revert applied to prod at 6532110008. verification: scim-service Decrypt OK for both alias/redwood-2026-rot and alias/redwood-legacy-2025.
scim-svc: dedupe tool run: scanned=1800 candidates, dupes=150, safe-to-requeue=1450
kevin b.: good. audit backfill will be run with origin=backfill flag so downstream consumers can ignore duplicates. ops, please rate-limit the backfill to avoid another surge.
audit-bot: backfill started at 6532110012 with throttling=200/s
lyla park: follow-ups: a) add a pre-deploy RBAC check that confirms active decrypt for service principals across previous alias patterns b) block combined KMS alias rotation + RBAC removals in single roll unless gated canary passes c) increase audit-ingestor heap target and add a spill-to-disk buffer to avoid GC-drop gaps.
dmitri kozlov: opening tickets: SEC-1301 (pre-deploy decrypt check), INF-3409 (canary-decrypt gating), AUD-217 (ingestor buffering).
kevin b.: assign owners: dmitri=RBAC revert guardrails, lyla=dedupe & replay orchestration, infra=ingestor tuning. i'll keep monitoring metrics for deprov churn and audit lag.
scim-svc: retry queue drained, requeue rate steady.
lyla park: incident channel is INC-2026-0512. status: mitigated (RBAC revert applied, backfill running). thanks all :pray:
